intent: Re-admit the SADHANA runtime authority slice after the operator-authorized bounded-attempt and automatic-verifier expansion. Exact campaign dispatches carry a zero-based generation through authority, lease, request, owner identity, run, claim, and idempotency evidence; only an exact pre-provider dispatch_indeterminate generation may advance below the precommitted goal ceiling, while prior evidence remains terminal. The sole campaign leader also replays or runs the existing distinct-family inference-only verifier and submits its typed verdict without changing generic routing or retry behavior.

commit.message: governance: admit bounded SADHANA attempt generations

interface_mismatches: TaskBoard historically stored one mutable execution marker, while bounded retry needs immutable terminal evidence for every generation and one current successor authority without resurrecting a prior identity.

Generic Orchestrator retry requeues a failed task under one identity; typed campaign attempts require a fresh request, lease, run, claim, and idempotency identity and may advance only before any provider scheduling witness.

The independent verifier runner is currently a manual CLI even though campaign dependency readiness requires accepted evidence; the sole leader must invoke its existing deterministic replay path automatically.

Verifier evidence and run terminal state are separate writes; replay must recover only its own exact completed evidence after a crash and must never repeat a provider effect merely because the terminal lifecycle write was interrupted.

TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore remain separate durability domains. The reconciler must plan and validate the whole campaign before writing, then use exact ownership-CAS transitions and leave indeterminate evidence visible on any unresolved partial.

dharmagraph-engine-2026-07 retains ownership of dharma_swarm/orchestrator.py and tests/test_orchestrator.py; its existing separately governed packet will be rebound for only the exact generation selector/scheduling-witness/generic-retry bypass seam.

dharma_swarm/agent_runner.py is admitted under dharmagraph solely for public ownership-CAS reserve/release methods under the existing pool lock; it does not expose the lock or claim OS/tool sandboxing.

mission_control_bootstrap.py remains organism-owned; its amendment is limited to generation correlation output and a behavior-preserving lock-helper extraction required by the enforced 1000-line ceiling.
honest_blockers: This admission changes no runtime code, task, lease, provider, process, verifier verdict, acceptance, merge, deployment, or external state.

Allowed-file policy is governance metadata, not OS/tool confinement. Write-capable campaign dispatch remains disabled without an actually enforced disposable-workspace/sandbox boundary; the admitted runtime route is inference/read-only only.
The exact principal thread is a trusted-process boundary for the sole production supervisor, not an opaque capability membrane against hostile in-process plugins.
An already-submitted provider effect is not cancelled by campaign stop; stop fences new durable submissions and cycles, while provider cancellation/revocation remains a separately owned follow-up.
Distinct-family model verification is semantic evidence, not truth by consensus and not promotion, merge, publication, or external-world success.
session_entry.rollback: Stop the campaign writer, revert the later implementation commit and this admission, and retain all canonical TaskBoard/RuntimeState evidence for audit. Do not delete prior generation rows or verifier evidence. The rollback removes only code paths and generated governance mirrors; no provider cancellation, credential mutation, promotion, merge, deployment, or external publication is authorized.
